about_the_game:
Prepare to set sail in a sandbox colony simulation blending vast ocean exploration with strategic crew management. Roam uncharted waters, discover islands, and shape your legacy at sea whether as an honorable captain, cunning smuggler, or ambitious faction leader.

Lead your crew as they gain experience, build reputations, and navigate alliances and rivalries. Support local empires, embrace piracy, or forge your own path. Keep your crew fed, content, and united, making critical decisions that shape your shared destiny. Your vessel is your colony, workshop, and fortress. Customize its interior, craft resources, and balance trade, adventure, and survival in a world where every choice matters.

FEATURES

• Open-Ended Exploration – Sail wherever you please in a living ocean filled with diverse island settlements, each governed by its own politics and unique outlook on the world.

• Evolving Captain and Crew – Grow stronger by earning experience through trade, naval battles, or diplomacy. Your skills and those of your crew improve as you tackle new challenges.

• Deep Faction System – Encounter various cultures and powers vying for control. Improve (or sabotage) your standing with them, join their cause, or establish your own faction to command the seas.

• Living Shipboard Community – Manage essential resources and the morale of your crew. Every decision you make, from rationing supplies to dealing with mutinous behavior, can change your crew’s loyalty and performance.

• Customize and Produce – Outfit your vessel with workshops and crafting stations suitable to its size and your leadership style. Create gear, refine materials, and stock provisions for lengthy voyages.

• Dynamic Sandbox Gameplay – Shape your own story in a reactive world driven by strategy, diplomacy, and resource management. Every choice leaves its mark on your voyage.

• Rich Dialogues and Encounters – Cross paths with an array of characters, each with their own agendas. Forge friendships or spark rivalries through direct conversations and carefully chosen actions.

• Tempting Adventures and Rare Rewards – Venture into mysterious waters, daring islands, and treacherous territories that beckon explorers and risk-takers alike. Face off against fierce enemies guarding valuable treasures, rare loot, and secrets waiting to be uncovered by only the boldest captains.

Chart your course, and unleash your ambitions upon this vast ocean of endless possibilities. Your ship is your domain, your crew is your family, and your dreams are what will steer you through storms to victory or oblivion!

name: The Black Bahr

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel® UHD Graphics 630 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 660 2GB / AMD Radeon™ HD 7850 2GB
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 3GB / AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: The Black Bahr is a sandbox colony simulation RPG blending ocean exploration, crew management, and dynamic faction politics. Freely chart your course as a pirate, merchant, or honorable captain, shaping your destiny across the open seas.
supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
